title: Extract figures with page evidence
goal: Extract numerical facts without losing units, scope or page references.
explanation: PDF text can be rearranged, OCR can misread digits, and annual and quarterly totals are not directly comparable. This fixture is a short original report; use it first, then optionally test a public document you are allowed to upload. Every number needs a source location and an uncertainty label.
sampleInput: Fictional report, page 1: “Technology investment, FY2025: $120,000; FY2024: $95,000.” Page 2: “Marketing spend, Q1 2025: $18,000. Marketing spend, Q2 2025: not disclosed.” Page 3 note: “Figures are USD, before tax; investment excludes recurring software subscriptions.”
prompt: Extract technology investment and marketing spend into a table: metric, period, value, unit, page, exact supporting quote, exclusions/uncertainty. Keep not-disclosed values as null/not disclosed. Do not estimate missing quarters, combine periods or convert currencies.
workedExample: Technology investment | FY2025 | 120000 | USD before tax | p1. Marketing spend | Q2 2025 | not disclosed | USD | p2. A yearly marketing total cannot be calculated from a single disclosed quarter.

steps.title: Read the fixture first
steps.text: Build a manual reference table, including the scope note and missing value.

steps.title: Run extraction
steps.text: Paste the page-labelled text or upload the original fixture report from the pack where supported.

steps.title: Verify each cell
steps.text: Trace every figure to the exact page and quote; compare zeros, commas and period labels.

steps.title: Introduce an OCR trap
steps.text: Replace 120,000 with 12O,000 using the letter O. Check whether it flags ambiguity instead of silently asserting a value.

steps.title: Extend carefully
steps.text: Try a permitted public report and record the document version, page numbering and extraction limits.

checks: Every numeric row has the correct period, USD unit and page/quote evidence.
Not disclosed remains missing; no annual marketing total is invented.
The OCR ambiguity and subscription exclusion are visible in the final notes.
commonMistakes: Comparing a quarter with a full year as though they share a denominator.
Confusing the PDF viewer’s page number with the printed page label.
offline: Complete the reference table manually from the supplied page-labelled text; OCR and upload features remain untested.
reflection: Which number would be most misleading if its period label disappeared?

evidence.title: Keep the build
evidence.detail: Save your original input, exact prompt and resulting artifact. Every numeric row has the correct period, USD unit and page/quote evidence.

evidence.title: Show what you tested
evidence.detail: Record a pass/fail result and evidence for every check below. Not disclosed remains missing; no annual marketing total is invented.

evidence.title: Explain a limitation
evidence.detail: Write what changed after one deliberate revision and name a remaining failure mode. Comparing a quarter with a full year as though they share a denominator.
